hook: A map of mental health: what eight common conditions are and are not, how common they are and what helps. Then twelve myths and facts, two practice conversations for helping a friend, and a stress bucket.
outcome: Describe common mental health conditions and the mental health continuum, correct myths that feed stigma, practice noticing, asking, listening and connecting a friend to help, and identify healthy and unhealthy ways to manage stress
sources: NIMH, National Comorbidity Survey Adolescent Supplement
SAMHSA, National Survey on Drug Use and Health 2024
CDC, ADHD data from the 2022 National Survey of Children's Health
Crisis lines (988, Crisis Text Line, The Trevor Project, Teen Line, SAMHSA Helpline) checked October 2026
Illustrations drawn with FLUX.1-schnell (Apache 2.0) on a local computer, edited for Curio Class
